verdict.rationale: v0 is itself a built-in AI assistant that users delegate coding/build tasks to: docs show it plans, creates tasks, connects to databases, diagnoses and fixes build/CI errors autonomously (v0-docs-35, v0-docs-9/17/20, v0-docs-26), and community reports confirm a full 'dev-to-deploy' delegation experience with an MVP built end-to-end (v0-comm-1). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of autonomous task delegation beyond anecdote, and no detail on multi-step task planning transparency.
